Hello again! I am Ananse. Today we will break five into two parts.
Here are five mangoes. Let us count them.
Five mangoes. Now watch my stick.
Zero here, and five there. Zero and five make five.
One here, and four there. One and four make five.
The stick keeps walking. Count the parts with me.
Five here, and zero there. Five and zero make five.
Look at these two. One and four. Four and one.
It is the same five, turned around.
No mango came, and no mango went. Five is always five.
Off you go and feed Ananse. Pick up the mangoes, and count them as you go.
